arxiv.abstract: Metaheuristic-based global optimization with embedded, long-running simulations is a computationally expensive process. To support various stages of development and execution, a seamless transition from personal computers to distributed clusters is desired, enabling execution across all computational scales. arxiv.abstract: Matrix-orthogonalization-based optimizers, exemplified by Muon, have demonstrated strong convergence behavior across a wide range of modern deep learning workloads. arxiv.title: BtrLog: Low-Latency Logging for Cloud Database Systems
arxiv.abstract: Cloud database systems cannot rely on instance-local disks for write-ahead logging (WAL) durability, forcing WAL onto remote storage. Existing options are unsatisfying: remote block storage like EBS is easy to adopt but adds substantial write latency and cost, while object storage offers excellent durability and low storage cost but is impractical for OLTP due to high latency and per-append cost.

arxiv.abstract: State-of-the-art AI training simulators assume homogeneous compute and network infrastructure. arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale large language models (LLMs) to hundreds of billions of parameters. Serving a single MoE model requires multiple GPUs operating in parallel, typically through tensor parallelism (TP) or expert parallelism (EP). arxiv.abstract: Learned sparse retrieval models such as SPLADE achieve retrieval quality competitive with dense models while preserving the interpretability and exact-match advantages of sparse representations. arxiv.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence shows great promise for radically improving the pace of innovation in hardware/software co-design research across computer architecture, systems, compilers, and VLSI. arxiv.abstract: The push towards expanded ultra-low-power edge computing necessitates hardware capable of operating under extremely strict energy constraints. arxiv.abstract: Modern edge computing applications, particularly high-throughput stream processing like Vision Transformers (ViTs), demand massive spatial parallelism and efficient data movement under tight power and area constraints. arxiv.abstract: Apple silicon exposes unified CPU-GPU memory, but the cache state left after a completed GPU command is not documented. This paper characterizes that phase boundary on a 14-core Apple M4 Pro. arxiv.abstract: This paper presents a deep learning-assisted methodology for the inverse synthesis of a compact, wideband inverted Doherty power amplifier (PA). arxiv.abstract: Generalized sparse matrix-matrix multiplication (SpGEMM) is critical in many domains. arxiv.abstract: As hardware security threats escalate across semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging, there is a growing need for novel physical mechanisms to counter sophisticated attacks such as tampering, counterfeiting, and supply chain infiltration. arxiv.title: Query Cost Model Calibration in Confidential Virtual Machines
arxiv.abstract: With the growing adoption of Confidential Computing, running databases in confidential virtual machines (CVMs) such as AMD SEV-SNP has become an attractive way to protect sensitive cloud data with minimal changes to legacy DBMSs. arxiv.title: SOLAR: AI-Powered Speed-of-Light Performance Analysis
arxiv.abstract: How fast could a deep-learning model run on target hardware, and how far is today's implementation from that limit? These questions are central to software, hardware, and algorithm optimizations. arxiv.title: Beyond Objects
arxiv.abstract: A core principle of object orientation -- that the functionality of a system can be partitioned amongst objects that correspond to individuals in the problem domain -- has influenced how software has been specified, designed and implemented for more than fifty years. arxiv.title: Welterweight Go: Boxing, Structural Subtyping, and Generics (Extended Version)
arxiv.abstract: Go's unique combination of structural subtyping between generics and types with non-uniform runtime representations presents significant challenges for formalising the language. arxiv.title: Mostly Automatic Translation of Language Interpreters from C to Safe Rust
arxiv.abstract: Translating C programs to safe Rust is challenging owing to significant differences in typing constraints, ownership, and borrowing rules. Interpreter programs are particularly important targets for such translation, as they often handle untrusted inputs and suffer from memory-related vulnerabilities. arxiv.title: Formalizing a Many-Sorted Hybrid Polyadic Modal Logic in Lean
arxiv.abstract: We present a Lean formalization of a general hybrid modal logic with many-sorted signatures and polyadic modal operators. arxiv.title: Compiler-Driven Approximation Tuning for Hyperdimensional Computing
arxiv.abstract: As Moore's law reaches its physical and economic limits, domain-specific approaches are increasingly employed to accelerate machine learning workloads. arxiv.title: Theory-Scale Auto-Formalization of Logics for Computer Science
arxiv.abstract: Auto-formalization is critical for scalable formal verification, but existing progress largely focuses on isolated statements, while theory-scale auto-formalization, which coherently translates hundreds of interdependent definitions, lemmas, and theorems, remains open due to challenges in consistency, faithfulness, scalability, and correctness. arxiv.title: An Empirical Study of LLM-Generated Specifications for VeriFast
arxiv.abstract: Static verification tools can assure industrial scale software, but require significant human labor to write specifications. arxiv.title: A Typestate Approach to Purpose-aware Programming
arxiv.abstract: Real-world applications often require verification that sensitive data is being used for their intended purpose. However, existing literature offers limited results regarding compile-time guarantees in this domain. In this paper, we explore the use of typestate to reason about the purpose of data. arxiv.title: Axon: A Synthesizing Superoptimizer for Tensor Programs
arxiv.abstract: Writing high performance kernels for AI accelerators requires deep expertise in tiling, instruction selection, data layout, and operator fusion placing a significant burden on programmers. arxiv.title: A Survey of Quantum Programming Languages
arxiv.abstract: Quantum computing has seen multiple recent breakthroughs and is getting closer to demonstrations of an exponential advantage over classical computing for certain problems. arxiv.title: DanceOPD: On-Policy Generative Field Distillation
arxiv.abstract: Modern image generation demands a single model that unifies diverse capabilities, including text-to-image (T2I), local editing, and global editing. However, these capabilities are rarely naturally aligned and often conflict. For instance, editing tends to degrade T2I performance, while global and local editing interfere with each other. arxiv.title: Reinforcement Learning without Ground-Truth Solutions can Improve LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for training LLMs typically rely on ground-truth answers to assign rewards, limiting their applicability to tasks where the ground-truth solution is unknown. arxiv.title: Autoregressive Boltzmann Generators
arxiv.abstract: Efficient sampling of molecular systems at thermodynamic equilibrium is a hallmark challenge in statistical physics. arxiv.abstract: Many decoding methods for large language models can be understood as shifting probability mass toward outputs that are more likely under the model, either locally at the token level or globally at the sequence level. arxiv.title: Error-Conditioned Neural Solvers
arxiv.abstract: Neural surrogate models offer fast approximate mappings from PDE parameters to solutions, but they typically treat solving as a purely statistical task: once trained, they struggle to correct their own constraint violations and extrapolate beyond the training distribution. arxiv.title: Understanding Domain-Aware Distribution Alignment in Budgeted Entity Matching
arxiv.abstract: Entity Matching (EM) is a core operation in the data integration pipeline, where records from different sources are compared to determine whether they refer to the same real-world entity. arxiv.title: Empowering GUI Agents via Autonomous Experience Exploration and Hindsight Experience Utilization for Task Planning
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal web agents can assist humans in operating repetitive GUI tasks, where effective task planning is essential for decomposing complex tasks into executable actions. While small open source MLLMs are cost efficient and privacy preserving compared with commercial large models, they suffer from weak planning and limited cross website generalization. arxiv.title: Beyond the Hard Budget: Sparsity Regularizers for More Interpretable Top-k Sparse Autoencoders
arxiv.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become a leading tool for interpreting the representations of vision foundation models, decomposing their polysemantic activations into a larger set of sparse, more monosemantic features. arxiv.title: Blackwell Approachability and Gradient Equilibrium are Equivalent
arxiv.abstract: Gradient equilibrium (GEQ) is a recently introduced online optimization framework that generalizes first-order stationarity from offline optimization and abstracts problems like online conformal prediction. items.title: OpenAI 发布首款自研芯片，由博通代工
items.summary: OpenAI 推出首颗定制 AI 芯片，由 Broadcom 设计代工——继 Google TPU、Amazon Trainium 之后，又一家头部 AI 公司走向自研算力，意在降低对 Nvidia 的依赖并优化自家训练/推理成本结构。

items.title: AMD Strix Halo RDMA 集群搭建指南
items.summary: 社区放出在 AMD Strix Halo APU 上配置 RDMA 集群跑 vLLM 的实操指南，展示了非 Nvidia 平台做分布式推理的可行路径，对关注国产/替代算力栈的读者有参考价值。

items.title: SOLAR：AI 驱动的 Speed-of-Light 性能分析
items.summary: 提出用模型预测深度学习负载在目标硬件上的理论性能上限（光速性能），并量化当前实现与上限的差距，是软硬件协同优化中定位瓶颈的有用方法学。

items.title: SegFold：细粒度动态数据流加速稀疏 GEMM
items.summary: 针对 SpGEMM 在 CPU/GPU 及专用加速器上因静态数据流导致的低效，提出细粒度动态数据流架构，对稀疏计算加速器设计有借鉴意义。

items.title: CHIA：开源的 Agentic AI 驱动软硬件协同设计框架
items.summary: 面向计算机体系结构研究，用 agentic AI 自动化 HW/SW co-design 流程，是「LLM 进入编译/体系结构设计闭环」趋势的最新开源实践。

items.title: 面向超维计算的编译器驱动近似调优
items.summary: 在摩尔定律放缓背景下，用编译器自动做近似度调优来加速 ML 负载（超维计算 HDC），体现「编译器承担精度-性能权衡」的方向。

domains.name: AI 推理优化（数据中心）

items.title: DSpark：投机解码加速 LLM 推理（DeepSeek）
items.summary: DeepSeek 放出 DSpark 论文，用投机解码（speculative decoding）显著加速大模型推理。HN 高热（772 分），是本周推理优化方向最受关注的工程进展。

items.title: Moebius：MoE 模型服务的无缝运行时并行切换
items.summary: MoE 模型服务需多 GPU 协同，Moebius 实现运行时并行策略的无缝切换，提升 MoE 推理的资源弹性与吞吐，是数据中心侧 MoE serving 的实用工作。

items.title: RolloutPipe：解耦式 On-Policy LLM 后训练中的流水线重叠
items.summary: 面向 RLVR 推理后训练，将 rollout 与 training 在解耦架构下流水线重叠，缓解 RL 后训练的吞吐瓶颈，对做 RLHF/RLVR 训练基础设施的团队有价值。

items.title: BtrLog：云数据库的低延迟日志
items.summary: 云数据库无法依赖本地盘做 WAL 持久化，被迫写远程存储；BtrLog 针对该场景优化低延迟日志，是大规模云基础设施存储路径优化的代表性工作。

items.title: 异构 AI 系统中统一张量重切分的模拟
items.summary: 现有训练模拟器假设算力/网络同构，但真实训练基础设施日益异构；该工作模拟异构系统下的张量 resharding，对大规模训练集群规划有参考。

items.title: 美国政府将审定谁能使用 GPT-5.6
items.summary: 据华盛顿邮报，OpenAI 称美国政府将参与审核其最新模型 GPT-5.6 的使用者准入。前沿模型出口/准入管制进一步制度化，HN 本周第一热帖（1164 分）。

items.title: Anthropic 指控阿里巴巴非法提取 Claude 模型能力
items.summary: 路透报道 Anthropic 称阿里巴巴非法蒸馏/提取其 Claude 模型能力。模型能力窃取与跨境治理成为焦点，叠加出口管制，是本周治理主线。

items.title: 美国允许 Anthropic 向「受信」美企发布 Mythos 模型
items.summary: Semafor 报道美方批准 Anthropic 向部分受信美国机构发布强力模型 Mythos，叠加随后亚洲创业公司推出对标模型，凸显出口禁令下的供给重构。

domains.name: 具身智能（基础设施视角）
AI 自动算子与代码生成优化

items.title: CHIA 框架（亦见编译器栏）：AI 自动化软硬件协同
items.summary: 用 agentic AI 自动驱动硬件/软件协同设计，与「AI 自动生成/调优算子与硬件」方向高度相关，可视作自动算子生成在体系结构层的延伸。

items.title: Apple M4 Pro 上 GPU 命令完成后的残留缓存状态
items.summary: Apple silicon 统一内存下，GPU 命令完成后的缓存状态缺乏文档；该工作刻画了这一相位边界，对在 Apple ANE/GPU 上做端侧推理优化与安全分析有参考。

items.title: 面向超低功耗边缘的 IMPLY 忆阻存内计算指令集
items.summary: 为极严苛能耗约束的边缘计算设计基于 IMPLY 的忆阻存内处理阵列指令集，代表端侧/边缘极低功耗推理硬件的前沿探索。

highlights: 算力自研成潮：OpenAI 发布首款博通代工的自研 AI 芯片，头部公司加速摆脱对 Nvidia 的单一依赖。
治理收紧主线：美政府将审定 GPT-5.6 用户准入、Anthropic 指控阿里非法提取 Claude、Mythos 受限发布——出口管制与模型能力保护成本周最强信号。
推理优化落地：DeepSeek DSpark 投机解码（HN 772 分）+ Moebius MoE 运行时并行切换，数据中心侧吞吐优化持续推进。
